summary: VirnetX Holding Corp filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing an At the Market Offering Agreement with Titan Partners Securities LLC as sales agent for up to $19,135,717 of common stock sold from time to time under its existing Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-295960). A Rule 424(b) prospectus supplement was filed the same day. The agent receives a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds and may sell on Nasdaq or in privately negotiated transactions with consent. Proceeds fund product development, marketing, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for dilution pace and any acceleration in selling pressure.
